```{r}
#| output: asis
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(jsonlite)
  library(htmltools)
})
payload <- tryCatch(fromJSON("landing_page_payload.json", simplifyVector = TRUE),
                    error = function(e) list())

# Stage order + titles/blurbs mirror KNOWN_REPORTS/STAGE_ORDER in build_report_site.py
stage_order <- c("mapping", "ambient", "qc", "per_sample_annotation", "cellsweep",
                 "hvg", "integration", "annotation", "other")

known <- list(
  "mapping_report.html" = list(stage = "mapping", title = "Mapping",
    desc = "Barcode knee plots and read-level mapping diagnostics across samples."),
  "knee_report.html" = list(stage = "ambient", title = "Mapping + cell calling (knee/shin)",
    desc = "Read mapping diagnostics and classic knee/shin cell calling, combined."),
  "cell_calling_report.html" = list(stage = "ambient", title = "Mapping + cell calling (GMM)",
    desc = "Read mapping diagnostics and splice-aware GMM cell calling: nuclei/ambient/damaged populations per sample."),
  "emptydrops_report.html" = list(stage = "ambient", title = "Cell calling (EmptyDrops)",
    desc = "DropletUtils emptyDrops cell calling: cells vs empty droplets per sample."),
  "ambient_report.html" = list(stage = "ambient", title = "Ambient RNA diagnostics",
    desc = "decontX summaries, contamination estimates, and ambient cleanup diagnostics."),
  "cellbender_report.html" = list(stage = "ambient", title = "CellBender diagnostics",
    desc = "Estimated-vs-called barcode comparisons and CellBender call diagnostics across samples."),
  "qc_report.html" = list(stage = "qc", title = "Cell-level QC",
    desc = "Filtering metrics, threshold summaries, and QC visualizations."),
  "per_sample_annotation_report.html" = list(stage = "per_sample_annotation", title = "Per-sample annotation",
    desc = "Per-sample normalize → HVG → PCA → Leiden → XGBoost annotation, used as CellSweep's per-cell-type input labels."),
  "cellsweep_input_report.html" = list(stage = "cellsweep", title = "CellSweep inputs",
    desc = "Audit of exactly which barcodes feed CellSweep."),
  "cellsweep_report.html" = list(stage = "cellsweep", title = "CellSweep decontamination",
    desc = "Ambient-fraction (alpha_hat) estimates per cell and per cluster from the EM denoiser."),
  "hvg_report.html" = list(stage = "hvg", title = "HVG selection",
    desc = "Highly variable gene selection diagnostics and ambient-gene context."),
  "integration_report.html" = list(stage = "integration", title = "Integration diagnostics",
    desc = "Harmony integration, clustering, metadata overlays, and QC-feature UMAPs."),
  "annotation_report.html" = list(stage = "annotation", title = "Annotation diagnostics",
    desc = "Marker-panel matching, cluster labels, and marker expression views.")
)

pretty_method <- function(m) {
  m <- gsub("(^|_)([a-z])", "\\1\\U\\2", m, perl = TRUE)
  m <- gsub("Xgboost", "XGBoost", m)
  gsub("_", " ", m)
}

file_stage <- function(f) {
  if (!is.null(known[[f]])) return(known[[f]]$stage)
  if (grepl("^annotation_report_.+\\.html$", f)) return("annotation")
  if (grepl("^zoom_.+\\.html$", f)) return("zoom")
  "other"
}
file_title <- function(f) {
  if (!is.null(known[[f]])) return(known[[f]]$title)
  if (grepl("^annotation_report_.+\\.html$", f))
    return(paste0("Annotation: ", pretty_method(sub("^annotation_report_(.+)\\.html$", "\\1", f))))
  if (grepl("^zoom_.+_report\\.html$", f))
    return(paste0("Zoom: ", pretty_method(sub("^zoom_(.+)_report\\.html$", "\\1", f))))
  f
}
file_desc <- function(f) {
  if (!is.null(known[[f]])) return(known[[f]]$desc)
  if (grepl("^annotation_report_.+\\.html$", f))
    return("Per-method annotation diagnostics, prediction confidence, and cluster-level label agreement.")
  if (grepl("^zoom_.+\\.html$", f))
    return("Subset rerun report for a configured zoom, including reintegration and top-marker summaries.")
  "Generated HTML report from this pipeline run."
}

files <- setdiff(sort(list.files(".", pattern = "\\.html$")), "index.html")

# Zoom targets are independent subset analyses -> each gets its own numbered
# step, never grouped. XGBoost annotation-method variants ARE variants of one
# conceptual step -> nested as an unnumbered sub-list under annotation_report.html.
zoom_files       <- files[grepl("^zoom_.+\\.html$", files)]
core_files       <- setdiff(files, zoom_files)
variant_files    <- core_files[grepl("^annotation_report_.+\\.html$", core_files)]
main_files       <- setdiff(core_files, variant_files)
main_files       <- main_files[order(match(vapply(main_files, file_stage, character(1)), stage_order))]

items <- list()
for (f in main_files) {
  sub <- character(0)
  if (file_stage(f) == "annotation" && length(variant_files) > 0) {
    sub <- sort(variant_files)
    variant_files <- character(0)
  }
  items[[length(items) + 1]] <- list(file = f, title = file_title(f), desc = file_desc(f), sub = sub)
}
for (f in variant_files) {  # only reached if no main annotation_report.html was present
  items[[length(items) + 1]] <- list(file = f, title = file_title(f), desc = file_desc(f), sub = character(0))
}
for (f in sort(zoom_files)) {
  items[[length(items) + 1]] <- list(file = f, title = file_title(f), desc = file_desc(f), sub = character(0))
}

cat("<h1>scQC-flow</h1>\n")
sub_line <- character(0)
if (!is.null(payload$run_name))     sub_line <- c(sub_line, sprintf("Run: %s", htmlEscape(payload$run_name)))
if (!is.null(payload$generated_at)) sub_line <- c(sub_line, sprintf("Generated: %s", htmlEscape(payload$generated_at)))
if (length(sub_line) > 0) cat(sprintf('<p class="sub">%s</p>\n', paste(sub_line, collapse = " &middot; ")))

cat("<ol>\n")
for (it in items) {
  cat(sprintf('<li><a href="%s">%s</a><span class="desc">%s</span>',
              htmlEscape(it$file), htmlEscape(it$title), htmlEscape(it$desc)))
  if (length(it$sub) > 0) {
    cat('<ul class="sub-links">')
    for (sf in it$sub) cat(sprintf('<li><a href="%s">%s</a></li>', htmlEscape(sf), htmlEscape(file_title(sf))))
    cat("</ul>")
  }
  cat("</li>\n")
}
cat("</ol>\n")
```
